reconstruction.basis: Retained source excerpts and task context, reviewed against the published original agent interfaces
reconstruction.qualification: The former environment and its unpublished proof files disappeared. This declaration starts new evidence; prior reported successes are not substituted for new execution or source comparison.

publicResponseTable.matching: Exact current public rows, frame hash, level, completed levels, public state, available actions, and actual released primitive command
publicResponseTable.otherwise: Return the identical public scene with the next actual step index
publicResponseTable.construction: The table uses only declared public geometry and commands. It never receives the current owner, proposal, tracker state or native expected result.

cases.publicPath: Right then left calibration; approach body x=9; ACTION5 moves the object to x=4,y=10; right joint transport to body x=22; ACTION5 puts the object at [25,9,28,12]; ACTION3 moves the body left while the object stays fixed
required: Cold ordinary selection
Selected and passive acquisition once
Arrival remains pending before separation
Observed separation affects the next actual common target and command
Checkpoint and shared caller-attention restoration

cases.publicPath: The first 23 public returns equal the positive case; the final ACTION3 moves the object left to [24,9,27,12] together with the body
required: The same actual separation command receives a contrary public result
Refutation is retained in tracker events even if the direct source return is another motion event
The original parent remains pending
The next actual common decision differs from the positive case

cases.publicPath: At the first ACTION5 contact, two compatible 4x4 objects appear at [4,10,7,13] and [12,10,15,13]
required: Identity remains unresolved
No held object is invented
The selected-frame parent is not silently replaced
The source owner abstains at the next decision

cases.publicPath: The selected-site ACTION5 returns the initial scene at level 2 with one completed level and available ACTION4
required: Natural boundary witnessed through the ordinary caller
Local core/moves/held/pending/observed-frame state is cleared
Conditional methods and goal evidence survive
Fresh caller attention and owner restoration preserve their separate responsibilities

cases.publicPath: Use the existing cold CommonMaterialReplay until a real typed-material pose-control parent with rule=null exists; acquire its recorded public return
required: No learned tracker or parent state is injected
Binding acquires passively
The other family's pending parent identity and owner remain intact
The owner rejoins the newly restored caller attention
cases.qualification: Native ownership/preservation extension. Typed-material parent revisions do not establish a replay of the entire original StrategyRouter.

cases.publicPath: The first real right translation establishes body knowledge, then the public interface offers only ACTION6. On the actual foreign click return, only the passive binding acquisition receives an expired NativeExecution deadline
required: Actual owner knowledge exists before the bound
No partial tracker or attention commit
Old observed_object_binding_state evidence is not marked fresh
The incomplete receipt binds the actual command and return
OP29/OP30/OP31 complete before stopping
Advance and resume release no further action
cases.qualification: Native execution-bound extension, not equivalence to the unbounded Python source. No result, proposal or learned state is injected.

cases.publicPath: After the first actual calibration return, the ordinary factory releases the first Binding ACTION3. Its declared public return is supplied, but only its selected recordSource call receives an expired NativeExecution deadline
required: The selected Binding action was ordinarily released before the bound is injected
No partial tracker or attention commit
No selected object_binding_event:null is invented for the incomplete source acquisition
Old observed_object_binding_state evidence is not marked fresh
The incomplete receipt has mode selected and binds the actual return
OP29/OP30/OP31 complete before stop
Resume releases no action
cases.qualification: Native selected-acquisition bound extension. The actual selected proposal and command remain unchanged; this is not an unbounded original-source equivalence claim.

cases.publicPath: The ordinary factory uses a shared controllable runtime clock, initially zero. After its actual first Binding ACTION3 return has passed the real after guard, the clock advances to 360001 ms. The caller execution deadline stays 900000 ms, and recordSource is left unchanged.
required: The action and public return are the same declared calibration transition
The real after result is returned unchanged before the clock advances
The runtime derives the acquisition bound from the exhausted 360000 ms level allowance
The refusal has exhausted_bound=deadline and belongs to the actual selected acquisition
No partial tracker, attention or fresh source fact is committed
OP29/OP30/OP31 complete before stopping
Resume releases no further action
cases.qualification: Native runtime scheduling proof with a declared controllable clock; no deadline, state, proposal or result is injected into recordSource. This is not unbounded original-source parity or a measured latency result.

callerEventContract: The original caller retains a selected object_binding_event even when its value is null; a passive null return does not create an event. Native incomplete acquisitions have their separate refusal receipt and do not count as completed source acquisitions.

journalContract.selectedCalls: The independent original replay uses its own latest proposal
journalContract.attention: External caller AttentionMemory calls are captured separately; calls inside a captured owner operation are not replayed twice
journalContract.memoryPuts: Native annotations contain per-call deltas; the original may expose a cumulative journal whose exact prefix and delta must both be checked
